pageCache.text:
Welcome to Robertswood School​​​​​​​
I am both extremely privileged and honoured to be the Headteacher of such a wonderful school. Robertswood is an exciting place where our children are at the heart of everything we do and we seek opportunities for children to learn in a safe and stimulating environment. The team work hard together to ensure that the children in our care thrive, succeed and grow into well-equipped and responsible citizens of the future, who value cultures and traditions other than their own and make a distinct contribution to the community and to society as a whole. The children at Robertswood are happy and successful; they grow, during their time with us, to be ambitious and resilient. Community is at the heart of our school and supported by brilliant staff, highly active governors and fantastic parents; we all strive to make the children’s learning experiences one of great joy and value. I look forward to welcoming you to Robertswood.
Emmeline Davison - Headteacher
